description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [ATK, MAG and MND +30% (25s)], [Haste], and [Quick Cast 2] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Protean Mode II (Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind)], [Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode I (Gogo (VI))] and [Black Magic Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode I (Gogo (VI))
description.text: Black Magic abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for Black Magic abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode II (Gogo (VI))]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode II (Gogo (VI))
description.text: Black Magic abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Black Magic abilities, grants [Dual Master Mimic Mode] after using Black Magic abilities

description.name: Dual Master Mimic Mode
description.text: Mimicked abilities deal 50% more damage, grants [Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Ability +30% Boost 1] and [Quick Cast 1] when another ally casts a Fire, Ice, Wind or Earth ability to the ally who casted the ability, casts the last ability used by another ally when another ally uses a Fire, Ice, Wind or Earth ability, removed after triggering six times

description.name: Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Ability +30% Boost 1
description.text: Fire, Ice, Wind and Earth abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: Protean Mode II (Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Earth/Wind ability

description.name: Black Magic Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Black Magic abilities deal 5% more damage
